meta.tagline: Connect hearts to masajid, wherever they are
meta.description: Masjid Hearts is a global initiative that connects one gift to a growing network of masajid: building, restoring and keeping the doors open for houses of Allah in need.

footer.note: Giving levels are symbolic. All contributions are pooled and allocated based on need.

hero.eyebrow: A global initiative for the houses of Allah
hero.lede: One gift reaches a growing network of masajid, not just one. Together we build, repair and keep the doors open for houses of Allah in need.

facts.title: One gift
facts.text: A small monthly sadaqah, given once and renewed.

facts.title: Pooled together
facts.text: Every contribution joins those of other givers.

facts.title: Sent where it is needed
facts.text: Allocated to masajid according to need.

journal.h2: Short reads on masajid, and why they matter.

mission.statement: To multiply your ongoing charity by connecting your heart to an entire
mission.p1: Most of us support one masjid: the one we pray in. Masjid Hearts lets a single donation reach across many communities worldwide, building, repairing and keeping the doors open for houses of Allah in urgent need.
mission.p2: One simple gift, an ever-growing network of masajid, and multiplied sadaqah jariyah (continuous charity) for your akhirah.

work.title: Build
work.text: A new masjid where a community has none.

work.title: Restore
work.text: A masjid that has been damaged or has fallen into disrepair.

work.title: Maintain
work.text: An existing place of worship, so it stays safe and open.

work.title: Sustain
work.text: The community a masjid serves: its prayer, its Qur’an, its people.

how.lede: You do not choose a single building. Your sadaqah joins a shared fund, and the fund goes to the masajid whose need is greatest at the time.

steps.title: You give a small amount each month
steps.text: A steady gift, however modest, is what lets a masjid plan beyond this week.

steps.title: It is pooled with other givers
steps.text: Small gifts combined are enough to lay a foundation or repair a roof.

steps.title: It is allocated by need
steps.text: Funds go to building, restoring, maintaining or sustaining masajid where support is needed most.

how.network: One heart at the bottom connected by lines to seven masajid above it.

why.alt: The prayer hall of a grand masjid: rows of red carpet running towards the mihrab beneath white arches and chandeliers.
why.quote: “Whoever builds a masjid for Allah, Allah will build for him a house like it in Paradise.”

give.h2: Help build, restore and sustain masajid.
give.lede: For a small monthly contribution, you help masajid remain places where generations come together to pray, learn Qur’an and strengthen their communities.
give.fine: Giving levels are symbolic. All contributions are pooled and allocated based on the needs of masajid and the communities they serve.

levels.title: Support 1 masjid
levels.line: Help support masajid and the communities they serve.

levels.title: Support 5 masajid
levels.line: Extend your support to more masajid and communities around the world.

levels.title: Support 10 masajid
levels.line: Make an even greater ongoing impact for masajid and the communities they serve.

contact.h2: Let’s keep the doors of a masjid open,
contact.lede: Whether you want to give, partner with us, or tell us about a masjid that needs help, we would love to hear from you.

who.title: Working together
who.text: Questions, ideas and partnership enquiries are welcome.
